Let's Build a Snowman!
история Speak & Smile · Спики и Coco лепят снеговика
тапни / стрелка →
It's snowing!
Let's build a snowman,
you and me!
🦝 Come on, Coco!
Roll, roll, roll!
Roll the snow —
big and round!
🐶 Woof! Bigger!
Put on the head!
One big ball,
one small ball on top!
🦝 Up it goes!
A hat and a nose!
A blue hat,
a carrot nose!
🦝 Look at his face!
A scarf and arms!
A red scarf,
two twig arms!
🐶 All done!
He's ALIVE!
The snowman winks —
hello, hello! Ha, ha, ha!
⛄ Hello, friends!
Happy winter!
Speaky, Coco and snowman —
best friends in the snow!
🦝🐶⛄ Hooray!
